text: Hi, I’m Volt! Steer left and right with the arrow keys. Give it a try!
Great steering! Now hold the up arrow to speed up. Down slows you down.
Zooming! Now press Space to jump. Glowing bridges cover the gaps until your first jump.
You’ve got it! Jump every gap and dive into the big port at the end!
Watch out! Red tiles short-circuit. Steer round them.
Battery low! Find a blue port!
No harm done, crashes just restart. Hit walls slower than half speed.
A data gate! Read the question, then steer into the lane with the answer.
